known_uncertainty.summary: Review by a qualified First Amendment and appellate practitioner remains pending; no independent review is recorded and no level-3 claim is made.
Automated schema, citation, deadline, and replay checks do not establish the legal accuracy, completeness, currency, or practical realism of the cited authorities or authored analysis.
Operation bindings, record tags, and classifications are authored for the exact identified documents and do not generalize to novel filings, altered bytes, or unreviewed procedural circumstances.

The structured-disposition schema encodes a limited Rule 65 corrective remand but has no independent field for non-vacatur or protection-remains-until-superseded. Those legally material limits must be stated consistently in the authored opinion, judgment, fact canon, and evidence narrative.

The workflow serializes district and appellate stay practice before merits briefing. It does not model concurrent emergency-motion and merits clocks, and its exact authored ordering must not be generalized to a live appeal with overlapping schedules.

Recurring-event mootness is an authored legal and factual branch supported by fixed documents and the cited Robinson proposition. The engine does not infer recurrence, ongoing exposure, cessation, or mootness from arbitrary records.

A custom originating-court role separates district operations from Fourth Circuit operations, but Fourth Circuit clerk and panel actors share the generic court role. Operation authorization therefore cannot enforce clerk-versus-panel identity beyond exact authored command and document bindings.

PA136–PA234 are never-filed counterfactual branch artifacts on a distinct synthetic docket. Actual-history and actual-record argument questions must exclude those pages even though the complete training record can resolve their anchors.

The B02 threshold denial, B05 impracticability denial, and B06–B07 grant/dissolution exercises stop as scoped appellate-stay endpoints. They abstract a neutral counterfactual notice and docket setup and do not claim complete alternate record, briefing, merits, or mandate dockets.

The bench profiles and oral-argument behavior are synthetic training constructs; differentiation and deterministic replay do not model any real judge or predict actual advocacy, questioning, or outcomes.

The PDFs are generated training artifacts. Source-to-PDF checks, accepted render inventories, and pinned hashes document repository provenance but cannot establish external authenticity, cross-render byte determinism, or complete accessibility and typography quality.
